Personal Financial Statement of:: Instructions Personal Financial Statement (PFS) is a statement of an individual's Net Worth. This documents includes all Assets & Liabilities with associated account information. Follow the below instructions for completing a PFS: 1) Gather financial account statements - See Checklist below for examples of types of accounts. 2) Enter the name of the bank/financial institution and the most recent value in the relevant section under each sub-header (e.g. Checking). 3) Add a new row if there are additional accounts under the sub-header. Make sure the sum total of the category includes all accounts. 4) Print, review, sign, and date the PFS. Calculation notes: Assets & Liabilities totals are derived from the section sub-headers, please ensure the sub-headers include a sum of all accounts.
